title: Accepted assignment with blank review metadata
journey: A resident compares two repair services.
objective: Prove that accepted assignments contain substantive review metadata.
constraints: Keep the invalid state limited to blank review metadata.

ai_steps.prompt: Inspect the assignment record and identify blank acceptance evidence.
Check whether the completion record contains substantive review metadata.

acceptance: The reviewed artifacts and human decision contain substantive text.
